content_sanskrit: अथ वीरवरोत्कण्ठनृत्यदप्सरसि स्थिता । लीलावलोकयामास व्योम्नि विद्यान्वितावनौ
padaccheda: अथ । वीरवरोत्कण्ठनृत्यदप्सरसि । स्थिता । लीला । अवलोकयामास । व्योम्नि । विद्यान्विता । अवनीम्
anvaya: अथ विद्या-अन्विता लीला वीर-वर-उत्कण्ठ-नृत्यत्-अप्सरसि व्योम्नि स्थिता (सती) अवनीम् अवलोकयामास ।
meaning_english: Then, the knowledge-endowed Līlā, standing in the sky where celestial nymphs were dancing in anticipation of the bravest heroes, gazed down upon the earth.

padaccheda: स्वराष्ट्रमण्डले । भर्तृपालिते । बलमालिते । कस्मिंश्चित् । विततारण्ये । द्वितीयाकाशभीषणे
anvaya: भर्तृ-पालिते बल-मालिते स्व-राष्ट्र-मण्डले द्वितीय-आकाश-भीषणे कस्मिंश्चित् वितत-अरण्ये (तौ ददर्श) ।
meaning_english: In a certain vast forest within her husband's kingdom, protected and encircled by his forces, she saw an army as formidable as a second sky.

content_sanskrit: सेनाद्वितयमाक्षुब्धं सौम्याब्धिद्वितयोपमम् । महारम्भघनं मत्तं स्थितं राजद्वयान्वितम्
padaccheda: सेनाद्वितयम् । आक्षुब्धम् । सौम्याब्धिद्वितयोपमम् । महारम्भघनम् । मत्तम् । स्थितम् । राजद्वयान्वितम्
anvaya: सौम्य-अब्धि-द्वितय-उपमम् महा-आरम्भ-घनम् मत्तम् राज-द्वय-अन्वितम् स्थितम् आक्षुब्धम् सेना-द्वितयम् (ददर्श) ।
meaning_english: She beheld two agitated armies, resembling a pair of calm oceans, dense with great preparation, intoxicated with pride, and stationed under the command of two kings.

padaccheda: युद्धसज्जम् । सुसंनद्धम् । इद्धम् । अग्निम् । इव । अद्भुतम् । पूर्वप्रहारसंपातप्रेक्षाक्षुब्धाक्षिलक्षितम्
anvaya: युद्ध-सज्जम् सु-संनद्धम् अद्भुतम् इद्धम् अग्निम् इव पूर्व-प्रहार-संपात-प्रेक्षा-क्षुब्ध-अक्षि-लक्षितम् (तत् सैन्यम्) ।
meaning_english: The army was ready for battle and well-armored, resembling a blazing, wondrous fire; their eyes were agitated as they watched for the fall of the first blow.
The soldiers bore streams of raised, stainless swords, while battle-axes, spears, slings, double-edged swords, and maces gleamed among them.
The forest trembled as if struck by the flapping wings of Garuḍa, while their golden coats of mail shimmered in the light of the rising sun.

padaccheda: परस्परमुखालोककोपप्रोद्दामितायुधम् । अन्योन्यबद्धदृष्टित्वात् । चित्रम् । भित्तौ । इव । अर्पितम्
anvaya: परस्पर-मुख-आलोक-कोप-प्रोद्दामित-आयुधम् अन्योन्य-बद्ध-दृष्टित्वात् भित्तौ अर्पितम् चित्रम् इव (स्थितम्) ।
meaning_english: With weapons raised in rage at the sight of each other's faces, they stood motionless like figures in a painting on a wall, their gazes fixed intently on one another.
Drawn up in long, disciplined lines, the great, unstoppable army’s clamor was so intense that their own conversations could not be heard.
The drums had long fallen silent in anticipation of the first strike, and the entire host remained slow and steady, with warriors fixed in their battle formations.

padaccheda: धनुर्द्वितयमात्रात्मशून्यमध्यैकसेतुना । विभक्तम् । कल्पवातेन । मत्तम् । एकार्णवम् । यथा
anvaya: धनुर्-द्वितय-मात्र-आत्म-शून्य-मध्य-एक-सेतुना विभक्तम् कल्प-वातेन मत्तम् एक-अर्णवम् यथा (तत् सैन्यम्) ।
meaning_english: The two armies were separated only by a narrow central space the width of two bows, appearing like a single intoxicated ocean divided by the cosmic winds at the end of an aeon.

The battle became a place where leaders were overwhelmed by the anxiety of physical peril, and the hearts of the distressed, as fragile as the skin of a croaking frog's throat, felt constricted like narrow caves.
Countless soldiers were prepared to sacrifice their very lives, while archers stood ready, their bows drawn to the ear, poised to release a torrential flood of arrows.
Innumerable soldiers stood motionless, watching for the fall of a blow, their faces tightened into fierce frowns due to the intensity of their mutual defiance and hard determination.
The armor produced harsh clanging sounds from constant collisions, while cowards sought hiding places, feeling scorched by the mere sight of the heroic warriors' faces.
Lives hung in uncertainty at a mere glance of the opposing formations; meanwhile, the hair on the bodies of tall, large elephants and men stood on end in intense excitement.

anvaya: पूर्व-प्रहार-संप्रेक्षा-व्यग्र-प्राणतया तया संशान्त-कल्लोल-रवम् निद्रा-मुद्र-पुर-उपमम् (तत् युद्धम् अभवत्)
meaning_english: Due to the life-breath being preoccupied with watching for the first strike, the roar of the waves of battle subsided, making the field resemble a city sealed in the silence of sleep.
The sounds of conches, trumpets, and drums were stilled, while the entire horizon between the earth and sky was enveloped by clouds of dust.
The central field was abandoned by those intent on fleeing, yet it shone like a vast ocean filled with countless fish and spreading formations of makaras (sea-monsters).
The clusters of banners surpassed the stars of the sky in number, while the trunks of elephants raised by the mahouts turned the intermediate space of the sky into a dense forest.

anvaya: तरत्-तरल-भा-पूर-सपक्ष-सकल-आयुधम् धमत्-धमिति-शब्दैः च श्वास-उत्थैः ध्माता-ख-अन्तरम् (तत् युद्धम् अभवत्)
meaning_english: All weapons seemed winged with the flowing flood of their own shimmering radiance, and the atmosphere was filled with the 'dham-dham' whistling sounds produced by the heavy breathing of the warriors.
The army shone with wicked warriors captured by the hands of the circular formation (cakravyūha) and featured a multitude of elephants fleeing from the fury of the eagle formation (garuḍavyūha).
With loud sounds rising from the broken front ranks of the hawk formation (śyenavyūha), massive groups of warriors fell completely as they collided with one another.
The army resounded with the cries of great heroes emitted from various tactical arrays, while circles of intoxicated maces were brandished and swung by their hands.
The sun was darkened by the cloud-like luster of dark weapons, and the sound of arrows resembled the whistling of dry grass tossed by the wind.

padaccheda: अनेककल्पकल्पाग्रसवृन्दम् । इव । संस्थितम् । प्रलयानिलसंक्षुब्धम् । एकार्णवम् । इव । उत्थितम्
anvaya: (तत् सैन्यं) अनेक-कल्प-कल्प-अग्र-स-वृन्दम् इव संस्थितम्, प्रलय-अनिल-संक्षुब्धम् एक-अर्णवम् इव उत्थितम् (आसीत्)।
meaning_english: It stood like a gathering of many ages at the end of a kalpa, rising like the single cosmic ocean agitated by the winds of dissolution.

content_sanskrit: सद्यश्छिन्नं महामेरोः पक्षद्वयमिव स्फुरत् । क्षुब्धमारुतनिर्धूतमिव कज्जलपर्वतम्
padaccheda: सद्यः । छिन्नम् । महामेरोः । पक्षद्वयम् । इव । स्फुरत् । क्षुब्धमारुतनिर्धूतम् । इव । कज्जलपर्वतम्
anvaya: (तत् सैन्यं) महा-मेरोः सद्यः छिन्नं स्फुरत् पक्ष-द्वयम् इव, क्षुब्ध-मारुत-निर्धूतम् कज्जल-पर्वतम् इव (आसीत्)।
meaning_english: The army appeared like the two throbbing wings of Mount Meru recently severed, or like a mountain of collyrium shaken by turbulent winds.

padaccheda: पातालकुहरात् । क्षुब्धम् । अन्धकारम् । इव । उत्थितम् । लोकालोकम् । इव । उन्मत्तनृत्यलोललसत्तटम् । महानरकसंघातम् । भित्त्वा । अवनिम् । इव । उत्थितम्
anvaya: (तत् सैन्यं) पाताल-कुहरात् क्षुब्धम् उत्थितम् अन्धकारम् इव, उन्मत्त-नृत्य-लोल-लसत्-तटम् लोकालोकम् इव, महा-नरक-संघातम् भित्त्वा अवनिम् उत्थितम् इव (आसीत्)।
meaning_english: It was like darkness rising agitated from the cavern of the underworld, like the Lokāloka mountain with its peaks swaying in a mad dance, or like the mass of great hells bursting through the earth.

padaccheda: आलोलकुन्तमुसलासिपरश्वधांशुश्यामायमानदिवसातपवारिपूरैः । एकार्णवम् । भुवनकोशम् । इव । अचिरेण । कर्तुम् । समुद्यतम् । अगाधम् । अनन्तपूरैः
anvaya: (तत् सैन्यम्) आलोल-कुन्त-मुसल-असि-परश्वध-अंशु-श्यामायमान-दिवस-आतप-वारि-पूरैः, अगाधम् अनन्त-पूरैः भुवन-कोशम् अचिरेण एक-अर्णवम् कर्तुम् समुद्यतम् इव (आसीत्)।
meaning_english: With floods of water-like luster from swaying spears, clubs, swords, and axes darkening the daylight, the army seemed ready to quickly turn the vessel of the universe into a single bottomless ocean with its infinite streams.
